corrections.issue: Blends three sources: Kelly argues for complex ML models with many factors, traditionalists warn of overfitting, but the 'simple models reach about 90% of the prediction' result comes from a separate fixed-income/equity-correlation paper (135 factors), not from Kelly.
corrections.fix: Kelly (AQR/Yale) argues for complex machine-learning models with many factors since prediction, not explanation, matters; traditionalists warn that complexity leads to overfitting and that limited factors do better over the long run.
